research.name: FarmUI
research.note: Domain no longer hosts a UI library and now redirects to an unrelated survey page.
unverified: On 2026-10-24 farmui.com returned HTTP 302 to survey-smiles.com and the browser landed on an unrelated age and gender survey page, so no product could be viewed.

The product name FarmUI is taken from the domain only; a GitHub repository farming-labs/farm-ui (498 stars, last pushed 2025-12-15) may be the former project but its link to this domain was not confirmed.
openSource, pricing and genericCollection are placeholders because the product could not be observed.
